THE SIZE GATE LANDS ON THE LAST EXECUTED PRINT, so the flagged count is VINTAGE-SENSITIVE. Three pulls of the same tape this morning (08:36, 08:40 and 08:42 ET) returned 2, then 0, then 3 flags from one unchanged rule: the 25-share test is applied to the size of the newest print, and the newest print of a liquid market is often an odd lot. Read the flagged count as 'on this vintage'.
